crossRefs.note: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take…
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me…
Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law…
They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.
Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as…
asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem; plotting to kill him on the way.
He will not strive, nor shout; neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the…
who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…

translations.web: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
translations.bsb: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
translations.kjv: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
translations.asv: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful words against them that are quiet in the land.
